precision.title: A Brow App You Can Fine-Tune
precision.description: Start with automatic face and eyebrow landmark detection, then make the shape your own. Browlens brings an eyebrow editor, a balance report, and AI photo previews into one place.

items.title: Six points. Your choice.
items.description: Use guide lines for the brow head, arch, and tail, then drag all six control points to correct their placement on your photo.

items.title: Adjust the details that matter
items.description: Fine-tune brow thickness, length, angle, spacing, overall height, and arch height. Adjust both brows together or refine each side.

items.title: Understand your brow balance
items.description: Read a report of arch-height and brow-length differences between your left and right brows. Compare measured differences without a beauty score.

items.title: See your new shape on your face
items.description: Choose a brow style and generate an AI photo preview using your confirmed brow placement. Compare it with your original photo and download the result.

faq.title: Your Brow App Questions, Answered
faq.description: How to analyze your eyebrow shape and try a new brow filter with Browlens.

items.question: What is Browlens?
items.answer: Browlens is the brow app for exploring your eyebrow shape with AI. Upload a photo, review your brow mapping, and choose a style to preview.

items.question: Can I analyze my brows for free without signing up?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload a photo and use the brow mapping and shape analysis tools without an account. Generating a new try-on image requires sign-in and credits; the tool shows the credit cost before you generate.

items.question: What photo should I upload?
items.answer: Use a clear, front-facing photo with even lighting and both eyebrows visible. Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP file up to 15 MB.

items.question: How do eyebrow filters work?
items.answer: Choose a brow style, check the brow mapping on your photo, then generate a preview to compare the look on your face.

items.question: Can I compare different eyebrow shapes?
items.answer: Yes. Try an eyebrow filter on your photo, compare the before and after, then explore another shape to find a look you like.

items.question: Will a preview match my final look exactly?
items.answer: A preview is a visual reference. Photo quality, your natural brows, and styling technique can affect the final result.

items.question: Can I manually edit my eyebrows?
items.answer: Yes. The homepage eyebrow editor lets you drag six control points and adjust thickness, length, angle, spacing, height, and arch height. Your confirmed guide is passed to the existing AI preview flow.

items.question: What does the brow analysis report measure?
items.answer: It compares arch height and brow length between the two brows in your photo. Measurements use photo pixels; camera angle and image quality can affect them.

faq.tip: Want a quicker try-on? Open the brow filter. Learn the basics in our eyebrow mapping guide, eyebrow shapes guide, or beginner’s shaping guide.
